treatment;</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HF7AB76A9CF254F89B7348074934F9A40"><enum>(2)</enum><text>provides to the parents of such minor a complete, printed list of potential side effects of such treatment, including any permanent risks relating to fertility and sexual function; and</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HF9AECC41AF73487198817C23129F6BAC"><enum>(3)</enum><text>received the written, informed consent of the parents of such minor for such treatment.</text></paragraph></subsection><subsection id="H29D2199EA12047A491885C9E0B6CE45F" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Civil action</header><paragraph id="HBBC84E2EE1974B91A0A85C3F81972372" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>A minor or a parent of a minor who is harmed by a violation of this section may bring a civil action against the health care provider in an appropriate district court of the United States to obtain appropriate relief.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HDC03EE286A004383BB7B1DCFCD4DECDF" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Statute of limitations</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An action under this subsection may be brought at any time prior to 30 years after the date on which the minor attains the age of majority. </text></paragraph></subsection></section><section id="H74C992B1532342E3872DDD8591634C7D" commented="no"><enum>8.</enum><header>Medical malpractice liability</header><subsection id="H94A2AFD09D6A4A418A1EE319FEB62F47" commented="no"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An individual may bring a civil action in an appropriate district court of the United States to obtain appropriate relief for any physical, psychological, or physiological harm caused by a sex-trait altering treatment performed on the individual when the individual was a minor against a medical practitioner, hospital, clinic, surgery center or other provider that performed or prescribed such treatment. If said civil action is successful, the individual will be awarded attorney’s fees and litigation costs, and treble damages. </text></subsection><subsection id="H90F0A048C99B4DF48A31B3894BBF39B9" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Statute of limitations</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An action under this subsection may be brought at any time prior to 30 years after the date on which the minor attains the age of majority. </text></subsection></section><section id="H69C32462FD7A4D8B98D33F97323D5113"><enum>9.</enum><header>Right of conscience for health care providers<editorial></editorial></header><subsection id="HAF332908E7C64AEEA22A4FB29E4A68EF" commented="no"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A health care provider may not be penalized, retaliated against, or otherwise discriminated against on the basis that the provider does not or declines to—</text><paragraph id="H44CE209775214290876619A953B58588"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">perform, refer for, pay for, or otherwise participate in sex-trait altering treatment;</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H2584577FE8DE4AEBAF1466E8CA62609D"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">provide or sponsor sex-trait altering treatment coverage; or</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H3C714F251CC645C5B68FAC07437B4841"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">facilitate or make arrangements for sex-trait altering treatment.</text></paragraph></subsection><subsection id="HFD5376CF7BC44DB0ABCEDC02A1C1AB24"><enum>(b)</enum><header>State requirement</header><paragraph id="H047B3FAAF8F04B9F8DF917F22754E2AF"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">No specified Federal funds (as defined in paragraph (2)) may be made available to a State that requires a health care provider to provide sex-trait altering treatments.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H261C6D33CE2341C6905489F49DC9A68A"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Specified Federal funds defined</header><text>For purposes of this subsection, the term <quote>specified Federal funds</quote> means any Federal funds made available under a program administered by the Department of Health and Human Services.</text></paragraph></subsection><subsection id="H8F0C7C60F7C7465D876D7F6BE31E79C5" commented="no"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Civil action</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A health care provider who is harmed by a violation of subsection (a) may, in a civil action, obtain all appropriate relief, including injunctive relief, declaratory relief, and compensatory damages to prevent the occurrence, continuance, or repetition of such violation and to compensate for losses resulting from the violation.</text></subsection><subsection id="H1A70CBCC9BE7483D9B5E87D03E8202C2"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Definition</header><text> The term <quote>health care provider</quote> includes—</text><paragraph id="H2690D7CE33FA433A85C2FA9B6CA31D58"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">an individual physician, health care assistant, nurse, pharmacist, health researcher, or other health care personnel;</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H22197D69B2B44AD3AFB59A884EA214C5"><enum>(2)</enum><text>a hospital, laboratory, pharmacy, health system, or other health care or medical research facility or organization (including a party to a proposed merger or other collaborative arrangement relating to health services, and an entity resulting therefrom);</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H18B450BF65DA497A81FE6D8722BB1EBD"><enum>(3)</enum><text>a provider-sponsored organization, an accountable care organization, or a health maintenance organization;</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H02DAFF6894424D9F91319924B4C4DCE4"><enum>(4)</enum><text>a social services provider that provides or authorizes referrals for health care services;</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H3F3D7373998645908B2727E08798DA2C"><enum>(5)</enum><text>a program of training or education in the health professions or medical research, a participant in such a program, or any individual applying or otherwise aspiring to participate in such a program;</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H3C480D3148334FFDA2611541B7333A5A"><enum>(6)</enum><text>an issuer of health insurance coverage or of a health plan; </text></paragraph><paragraph id="H871C6D937F8F49A19D884B56965EF293"><enum>(7)</enum><text>a health care sharing ministry;</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HBFCD14818C0141E8A1AE0592D4D63244"><enum>(8)</enum><text>a health insurance plan, including group, individual, or student health plans, or a sponsor or administrator thereof; and</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H7638B4D420B64AC7988F1894824903CC"><enum>(9)</enum><text>any other health care organization, program, facility, or plan.</text></paragraph></subsection></section><section id="HE3B88D2B55C34225B07AC7242A8CFA95" section-type="subsequent-section" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>10.</enum><header>Prohibition on Federal funds for providing sex-trait altering treatment to students without parental consent</header><subsection id="H24DBB8E6B6E8483883B642C385B8D5EB"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Notwithstanding any other provision of law, no Federal funds may be provided to an elementary school or secondary school that allows school personnel to provide, assist in providing, or otherwise support the provision of sex-trait altering treatment to a student without notifying the parents of the student and receiving written approval from such parents.</text></subsection><subsection id="H0D6245D374A545EDBE1BC743B3A1DB40"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section:</text><paragraph id="HC2633D9B3A314A62A3DBE130223408DF"><enum>(1)</enum><header>ESEA terms</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The terms <term>elementary school</term>, <quote>paraprofessional</quote>, <quote>parent</quote>, <quote>school leader</quote>, <quote>secondary school</quote>, and <term>specialized instructional support personnel</term> have the meanings given the terms in section 8101 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/20/7801">20 U.S.C. 7801</external-xref>).</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H2AF096DFC6CF4FF3BB2B047AD6E691CE"><enum>(2)</enum><header>School personnel</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>school personnel</term> includes—</text><subparagraph id="H3CF42FC4494340F6A4483348F7AAD364"><enum>(A)</enum><text>teachers;</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H388F03D581A84FDFB376DE8A05C75DCA"><enum>(B)</enum><text>paraprofessionals;</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H11958C9E84564953A61C97CB11B36585"><enum>(C)</enum><text>school leaders;</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H151B1AB3C68442B1812A96D3AF9489A5"><enum>(D)</enum><text>specialized instructional support personnel;</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="HCDEA069CB3D240AC9217F81DA293D34F"><enum>(E)</enum><text>volunteers performing services for a school; and</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="HBB70B0911D264232A1628B921392234B"><enum>(F)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">other support staff who are employed by a school or who perform services for a school on a contractual basis.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section><section id="HF58E7072EBF84406B799158FC2599E17"><enum>11.</enum><header>Definitions</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">In this Act: </text><paragraph id="H33172F4194AB4B1BB44E52F9EE8DC294"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Sex-trait altering treatment</header><text>The term <quote>sex-trait altering treatment</quote> means any medical or surgical service, including physician’s services, practitioner’s services, inpatient and outpatient hospital services, or prescribed drugs related to gender transition, other than an excepted service, that seeks to:</text><subparagraph id="HE5EFA7EFAB684F4EB6DBB87E2B934B2A"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Alter or remove physical or anatomical characteristics or features that are typical for the individual’s sex; or</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="HB27BDD15231A4B3DAAD020E072C3AF00"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Instill or create physiological or anatomical characteristics that resemble a sex different from the individual’s sex, including medical services that provide puberty blocking drugs, gender transition hormone therapy, or genital gender reassignment surgery or nongenital gender reassignment surgery knowingly performed for the purpose of assisting an individual with a gender transition.</text></subparagraph></paragraph><paragraph id="H73C35785CE4B431CBF977968A9C12520"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Sex</header><text>The term <quote>sex</quote> means the biological indication of being male or female, including sex chromosomes, and naturally occurring sex hormones, gonads, and nonambiguous internal and external genitalia present at birth.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H38B4730F706640498176D55CD10DA075"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Gender transition hormone therapy</header><text>The term <quote>gender transition hormone therapy</quote> means testosterone, estrogen, or progesterone given to an individual in an amount greater than would normally be produced endogenously in a healthy individual of that individual’s age and sex.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H20868D2E4B9743219860002012D174AE"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Gender</header><text>The term <quote>gender</quote> means the psychological, behavioral, social, and cultural aspects of being male or female.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H25D83090B9EF41ECBD7FC5B3F705595F"><enum>(5)</enum><header>Gender reassignment surgery</header><text>The term <quote>gender reassignment surgery</quote> means any medical or surgical service that seeks to surgically alter or remove healthy physical or anatomical characteristics or features that are typical for the individual’s sex, in order to instill or create physiological or anatomical characteristics that resemble a sex different from the individual’s sex, including genital gender reassignment surgery or nongenital gender reassignment surgery knowingly performed for the purpose of assisting an individual with a gender transition.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H2ADFE8B8030C43F19C9A84E9A7319B8F"><enum>(6)</enum><header>Gender transition</header><text>The term <quote>gender transition</quote> means the process in which an individual shifts from identifying with and living as a gender that corresponds to his or her sex to identifying with and living as a gender different from his or her sex, and may involve social, legal, or physical changes.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H4B0E39FC3487488389A165F660B98F50"><enum>(7)</enum><header>Genital gender reassignment surgery</header><text>The term <quote>genital gender reassignment surgery</quote> means a medical procedure knowingly performed for the purpose of assisting an individual with a gender transition, including the following:</text><subparagraph id="H9F8DA5E84C324CDF976075DC6D0AADEC"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Surgical procedures, including a penectomy, orchiectomy, vaginoplasty, clitoroplasty, or vulvoplasty for a male sex patient or hysterectomy or ovariectomy for a female sex patient.</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H3C23379B7D19436CAB072ADADFE30ED4"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Reconstruction of the fixed part of the urethra with or without a metoidioplasty.</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H638D9191EA7C4CC8AC1D241F1D05ED0F"><enum>(C)</enum><text>Phalloplasty, vaginectomy, scrotoplasty, or implantation of erection or testicular prostheses for a female sex patient.</text></subparagraph></paragraph><paragraph id="HC310D41E6AC24FE685B1B28BD0F0A41C"><enum>(8)</enum><header>Nongenital gender reassignment surgery</header><text>The term <quote>nongenital gender reassignment surgery</quote> means medical procedures knowingly performed for the purpose of assisting an individual with a gender transition, including the following:</text><subparagraph id="HB2E7AC089C7448F787F40A4D5AAA8CC8"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Surgical procedures for a male sex patient, including augmentation mammoplasty, facial feminization surgery, liposuction, lipofilling, voice surgery, thyroid cartilage reduction, gluteal augmentation, hair reconstruction, or associated aesthetic procedures.</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H841FA65AD9B5487E858936D1C806B143"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Surgical procedures for a female sex patient, including subcutaneous mastectomy, voice surgery, liposuction, lipofilling, pectoral implants, or associated aesthetic procedures.</text></subparagraph></paragraph><paragraph id="H941212A2C635489DB429E8A4BF00AC32"><enum>(9)</enum><header>Puberty blocking drugs</header><text>The term <quote>puberty blocking drugs</quote> means the following when used for the purpose of assisting an individual with a gender transition.</text><subparagraph id="HC81CC77CEBDA451FA3405893CDB87F92"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Gonadotropin releasing hormone analogues or other synthetic drugs used to stop luteinizing hormone and follicle stimulating hormone secretion; or</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H241DCB338DF14318811A5DC5788DFE96"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Synthetic antiandrogen drugs used to block the androgen receptor.</text></subparagraph></paragraph><paragraph id="H7C7D13225E9C4E1A81BA00B7F9D374D9"><enum>(10)</enum><header>Excepted service</header><text>The term <quote>excepted service</quote> means any of the following:</text><subparagraph id="H7452CA814E684445A2EBEF8AEB8E70EE"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Medical or surgical services furnished to an individual born with a medically verifiable disorder of sex development, including an individual with:</text><clause id="H520D89C4D1EB49828C4028DBFE47B651"><enum>(i)</enum><text>External sex characteristics that are irresolvably ambiguous;</text></clause><clause id="H710A042B7A5D4EE2B397246AFF217DF8"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>Forty-six XX chromosomes with virilization;</text></clause><clause id="H9007F2AD66A34E98AA17E0BFBAC1D2F7"><enum>(iii)</enum><text>Forty-six XY chromosomes with undervirilization; or</text></clause><clause id="HF0CB1239C97045DD811C189CB5C41A3D"><enum>(iv)</enum><text>Both ovarian and testicular tissue.</text></clause></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H9B660440E4C14708BB86815F0B51BEC3"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Medical or surgical services provided when a physician or practitioner has diagnosed a disorder or condition of sexual development that the physician or practitioner has determined through genetic or biochemical testing that the individual does not have normal sex chromosome structure, sex steroid hormone production, or sex steroid hormone action.</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="HD08C90BE3E674740A02EE3BAF97BBBF0"><enum>(C)</enum><text>The treatment of any infection, injury, disease, or disorder that has been caused by or exacerbated by the performance of sex-trait altering treatments.</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H106FD9DC900C458FB288AC6FB7E3CAC5"><enum>(D)</enum><text>Any medical or surgical service undertaken because the individual suffers from a physical disorder, physical injury, or physical illness that would, as certified by a physician or practitioner, place the individual in imminent danger of death or impairment of major bodily function unless the medical or surgical service is performed.</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H5E0893C9794B4F1C8150E3EC7E48DEFC"><enum>(E)</enum><text>Mental health or social services, other than sex-trait altering treatments.</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H6085D1586ED640E5B47FE04E8364F4B9"><enum>(F)</enum><text>Services for a disorder or condition of sexual development that is unrelated to a diagnosis of gender dysphoria or gender identity disorder.</text></subparagraph></paragraph><paragraph id="H08315438760A4EE8BE25B728CED978F3"><enum>(11)</enum><header>Minor</header><text>The term <quote>minor</quote> means an individual under 18 years of age.</text></paragraph></section></legis-body></bill>

<legis-type>A BILL</legis-type>
<official-title display="yes">To amend the Education Amendments of 1972 to provide that for purposes of determining compliance with title IX of such Act in athletics, sex shall be recognized based solely on a person’s reproductive biology and genetics at birth.</official-title>
</form>
<legis-body id="HBE32549D9CF240CBA392177FAA8CA9F0" style="OLC"> 
<section id="H4D3DF9FC63124E728AAF251D4A1DD934" section-type="section-one"><enum>1.</enum><header>Short title</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">This Act may be cited as the <quote><short-title>Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act of 2025</short-title></quote>.</text></section> <section id="H0EAA1AC8C420424AB8219675B7A71BF9"><enum>2.</enum><header>Amendment</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Section 901 of the Education Amendments of 1972 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/20/1681">20 U.S.C. 1681</external-xref>) is amended by adding at the end the following:</text> 
<quoted-block id="H19098402F7204E1CB1467A0880CEDC6D" style="OLC"> 
<subsection id="HA24C461083A74597B3F96DF8E72B5F78"><enum>(d)</enum> 
<paragraph id="H0B68E718BA60414EA7653DFA840BEA5D" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text>It shall be a violation of subsection (a) for a recipient of Federal financial assistance who operates, sponsors, or facilitates an athletic program or activity to permit a person whose sex is male to participate in an athletic program or activity that is designated for women or girls.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HAC7A88BFF61347868E1B2DE78FA9C1ED" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>For the purposes of this subsection, sex shall be recognized based solely on a person’s reproductive biology and genetics at birth.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H168642A316F946BA83586613B5780679" indent="up1"><enum>(3)</enum><text>For the purposes of this subsection, the term <quote>athletic programs and activities</quote> includes, but is not limited to, all programs or activities that are provided conditional upon participation with any athletic team.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HB5FBABCEAD69468C84C72053F616D6B3" indent="up1"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Nothing in this subsection shall be construed to prohibit a recipient from permitting males to train or practice with an athletic program or activity that is designated for women or girls so long as no female is deprived of a roster spot on a team or sport, opportunity to participate in a practice or competition, scholarship, admission to an educational institution, or any other benefit that accompanies participating in the athletic program or activity.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H6523E488EBBA4F65AF8344728648FBCD" indent="up1"><enum>(5)</enum><text>The Comptroller General shall carry out a study to determine the meaning of the phrase <quote>any other benefit</quote> as used in paragraph (4) by looking at benefits to women or girls of participating in single sex sports that would be lost by allowing males to participate. The study shall document the adverse psychological, developmental, participatory, and sociological results to girls of allowing males to compete, be members of a sports team, or participants in athletic programs, that are designed for girls, including displacement or discouragement from sports participation, deprivation of a roster spot on a team or sport, loss of the opportunity to participate in a practice or competition, loss of a scholarship or scholarship opportunities, loss or displacement of admission to an educational institution, deprivation of the benefit of an environment free of hostility based on sexual assault or harassment, or loss of any other benefit that accompanies participating in the athletics program or activity. Further, the Comptroller General shall submit to the Committee on Education and Workforce of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions of the Senate a report that contains the results of such study.</text></paragraph></subsection><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></section> </legis-body> </bill>

<legis-type>A BILL</legis-type>
<official-title display="yes">To deny tax deductions and other Federal funding for the costs of gender transition procedures.</official-title>
</form>
<legis-body display-enacting-clause="yes-display-enacting-clause" id="HDBF0B67E0C334367908D5F257A771522">
<section id="H896AC9CE58E14F63BD8677067E0CFA66" section-type="section-one"><enum>1.</enum><header>Short title</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">This Act may be cited as the <quote><short-title>No Subsidies for Gender Transition Procedures Act</short-title></quote>.</text></section> <section section-type="subsequent-section" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H97E1C02782DD4E19A841AEFC45774308"><enum>2.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Denial of medical expense tax deduction</header> <subsection id="H636ADF56A6DF4D70908721338EE17512"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Subsection (d) of <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/26/213">section 213</external-xref> of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new paragraph:</text>
<quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H728F6AD45A0A43EA8F15B241980D11D3">
<paragraph id="H5752FBA3D2124874AE3DD1C1256E5A1F"><enum>(12)</enum><header>Expenses relating to gender transition</header>
<subparagraph id="HE888B74086D6405294635949B083C884"><enum>(A)</enum><header>In general</header><text>The term <term>medical care</term> does not include any gender transition procedure.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HED2844E86A3C4D238EBEFC861F629CF6"><enum>(B)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>For purposes of this paragraph—</text>
<clause id="HEBAEBE783CD14746BD2F3407D6167E18"><enum>(i)</enum><header>Gender transition procedure</header>
<subclause id="HB7483489AE164871BB6DDE3343ED9C17"><enum>(I)</enum><header>In general</header><text>The term <term>gender transition procedure</term> means any hormonal or surgical intervention for the purpose of gender transition, including—</text> <item id="H069035B84E4E49A9B891DF5183D3234E"><enum>(aa)</enum><text>the provision of gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists or other puberty-suppression drugs or puberty-blocking drugs to stop or delay normally-timed puberty in an individual who does not identify as his or her sex,</text></item>
<item commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HB49923B041B346698EDF7596E24E66F0"><enum>(bb)</enum><text>the provision of testosterone, estrogen, progesterone, or other androgen blockers to an individual at doses which are supraphysiologic to what would normally be produced endogenously in a healthy individual of the same age and sex, with the intent to align an individual’s physical appearance with an identity that differs from his or her sex,</text></item> <item commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H9EB63F006BAE4CDD9C7772F6E3E9DC73"><enum>(cc)</enum><text>surgical procedures that attempt to transform an individual’s physical appearance to align with an identity that differs from his or her sex or that attempt to alter or remove an individual’s sexual organs to minimize or destroy their natural biological functions,</text></item>
<item id="H4DAA5FFAEF954F1C9878272C46393CAE"><enum>(dd)</enum><text>castration, vasectomy, penectomy, orchiectomy, vaginoplasty, clitoroplasty, vulvoplasty, mastectomy, hysterectomy, oophorectomy, ovariectomy, reconstruction of the fixed part of the urethra with or without metoidioplasty or phalloplasty, metoidioplasty, phalloplasty, vaginectomy, scrotoplasty, implantation of erection or testicular prostheses, reduction thyrochondroplasty, chondrolaryngoplasty, tubal ligation, sterilization, augmentation mammoplasty, placement of chest implants to create feminine breasts, placement of fat or artificial implants in the gluteal region, liposuction, lipofilling, voice surgery, hair reconstruction, pectoral implants, any plastic, cosmetic, or aesthetic surgery which feminizes or masculinizes the facial or other physiological features of an individual, and any removal of any otherwise healthy or non-diseased body part or tissue.</text></item></subclause> <subclause id="H535209762BC44AF5AB8821AC916482E2"><enum>(II)</enum><header>Exclusions</header><text>The term <term>gender transition procedure</term> does not include, when furnished to an individual by a health care provider with the consent of such individual (or, if applicable, such individual’s parents or legal guardian)—</text>
<item id="H7AEFC79068C14B228A831258DB46A2E0"><enum>(aa)</enum><text>services to individuals born with a medically verifiable disorder of sex development, including an individual with external sex characteristics which are irresolvably ambiguous, such as an individual born with 46 XX chromosomes with virilization, an individual born with 46 XY chromosomes with undervirilization, or an individual born having both ovarian and testicular tissue,</text></item> <item id="H892ECDCDFAAA4058B448E6CE59E891D7"><enum>(bb)</enum><text>services relating to any other physician-diagnosed disorder of sexual development with respect to which the physician has determined through genetic or biochemical testing that the individual does not have normal sex chromosome structure, sex steroid hormone production, or sex steroid hormone action for a healthy male or female of the same age,</text></item>
<item id="HAB5B68F8468744839F17C3CD33364378" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(cc)</enum><text>the treatment of any infection, injury, disease, or disorder caused or exacerbated by the performance of gender transition procedures, without regard to whether the gender transition procedure was performed in accordance with State and Federal law or whether the gender transition procedure is treated as medical care under this section,</text></item> <item id="H02CF32C0D7804218943B8D5C6ABAB8DD"><enum>(dd)</enum><text>any procedure undertaken because the individual suffers from a physical disorder, physical injury, or physical illness (but not mental, behavioral, or emotional distress or a mental, behavioral, or emotional disorder) which would, as certified by a physician, place the individual in imminent danger of death or impairment of major bodily function unless the procedure is performed to alleviate said physical disorder, physical injury, or physical illness,</text></item>
<item commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H872FA5C50D6E4204B78C95738B791279"><enum>(ee)</enum><text>procedures to restore or reconstruct the body of the individual in order to correspond to the individual’s sex after one or more previous gender transition procedures, which may include the removal of a pseudo phallus or breast augmentation,</text></item> <item id="HF498D020BDD34D7E89063F6190BFC879"><enum>(ff)</enum><text>puberty suppression or puberty-blocking prescription drugs for the purpose of normalizing puberty for a minor experiencing precocious puberty, or</text></item>
<item id="H9C8C1907B5AC4695BC53EEFBDB171650"><enum>(gg)</enum><text>male circumcision.</text></item></subclause></clause> <clause id="H9B7C3B46160E4B4A84F6CC5F2532B0B7"><enum>(ii)</enum><header>Gender transition</header><text>The term <term>gender transition</term> means the process by which an individual goes from identifying with or presenting as his or her sex to identifying with or presenting as a self-proclaimed identity which does not correspond with or is different from his or her sex, and may be accompanied by social, legal, or physical changes.</text></clause>
<clause id="H8A26BE7D30854989BCCB34EB2140CABD" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iii)</enum><header>Sex</header><text>The term <term>sex</term>, when referring to an individual’s sex, means either male or female, as biologically determined.</text></clause> <clause id="HC48585D8C52A4AF1BAC431FA184182D5"><enum>(iv)</enum><header>Female</header><text>The term <term>female</term>, when used to refer to a natural person, means a person belonging, at conception, to the sex characterized by a reproductive system with the biological function of producing eggs (ova).</text></clause>
<clause id="H102652BFB14B4A2B802DC18AADE299DB"><enum>(v)</enum><header>Male</header><text>The term <term>male</term>, when used to refer to a natural person, means a person belonging, at conception, to the biological sex characterized by a reproductive system with the biological function of producing sperm.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></subsection> <subsection id="H3AEFD690675A4873A78223818F1A6810"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Effective date</header><text>The amendment made by this section shall apply to taxable years beginning after the date of the enactment of this Act.</text></subsection></section>
<section id="HFD0F5480788047F4BC33C1A624085C40"><enum>3.</enum><header>Prohibiting Federal medicaid funding for gender transition procedures</header>
<subsection id="HBED59436D7B64441AF82AE56A99466E5"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Section 1903(i) of the Social Security Act (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/42/1396b">42 U.S.C. 1396b(i)</external-xref>) is amended—</text> <paragraph id="HDFA5DB08CCFA483FA36450C980D05DB7"><enum>(1)</enum><text>in paragraph (26), by striking <quote>; or</quote> and inserting a semicolon;</text></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H73ED405E9B504D46891F4EDC06DE267F"><enum>(2)</enum><text>in paragraph (27), by striking the period at the end and inserting <quote>; or</quote>;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H8E3453928BC84B899EFC3D8A423456A3"><enum>(3)</enum><text>by inserting after paragraph (27) the following new paragraph:</text>
<quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HA441DDD465A74D1A8438FB42DBA063F9">
<paragraph id="HB042F431CB9342F99C9BB6FF435AD497"><enum>(28)</enum><text>with respect to any amounts expended for any specified gender transition procedure (as defined in section 1905(kk)) to an individual enrolled in a State plan under this title (or a waiver of such plan), including any amounts expended for the administration of a State program that furnishes any such procedure.</text></paragraph><after-quoted-block>; and</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph> <paragraph id="HA65C6A3AD5B64B179D32F39CF1868B97"><enum>(4)</enum><text>in the flush left matter at the end, by striking <quote>and (18),</quote> and inserting <quote>(18), and (28)</quote>.</text></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H05B157BA0CD14F369DB0DB184455CE3B"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Prohibiting Federal medicaid funding for gender transition procedures</header><text>Section 1905 of the Social Security Act (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/42/1396d">42 U.S.C. 1396d</external-xref>) is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection:</text> <quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HCEA7D96A5173434C9988B45B6E2470A6"> <subsection id="H717678D254C04720AA3B2CD01B0C5DDF"><enum>(kk)</enum><header>Prohibiting Federal medicaid funding for specified gender transition procedures</header> <paragraph id="HD04E01E1AD474423AB2CCECADC58A830"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Specified gender transition procedures defined</header><text>For purposes of section 1903(i)(28), except as provided in paragraph (2), the term <term>specified gender transition procedure</term> means, with respect to an individual, any hormonal or surgical intervention for the purpose of gender transition, including—</text>
<subparagraph id="H89D0DD30FEB3478E9BA89F1A713A3DDF"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the provision of gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists or other puberty suppression drugs or puberty-blocking drugs to stop or delay normally timed puberty in an individual who does not identify as his or her sex;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HCABD6EB3E373411F9D558289AF149ACA"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the provision of testosterone, estrogen, progesterone, or other androgen blockers to an individual at doses which are supraphysiologic to what would normally be produced endogenously in a healthy individual of the same age and sex, with the intent to align an individual’s physical appearance with an identity that differs from his or her sex;</text></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB86C683F993D4F33A90FD7A90E030286"><enum>(C)</enum><text>surgical procedures that attempt to transform an individual’s physical appearance to align with an identity that differs from his or her sex or that attempt to alter or remove an individual’s sexual organs to minimize or destroy their natural biological functions; or</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H59ED121800564F21B9247D572D67B5AD"><enum>(D)</enum><text>castration, vasectomy, penectomy, orchiectomy, vaginoplasty, clitoroplasty, vulvoplasty, mastectomy, hysterectomy, oophorectomy, ovariectomy, reconstruction of the fixed part of the urethra with or without metoidioplasty or phalloplasty, metoidioplasty, phalloplasty, vaginectomy, scrotoplasty, implantation of erection or testicular prostheses, reduction thyrochondroplasty, chondrolaryngoplasty, tubal ligation, sterilization, augmentation mammoplasty, placement of chest implants to create feminine breasts, placement of fat or artificial implants in the gluteal region, liposuction, lipofilling, voice surgery, hair reconstruction, pectoral implants, any plastic, cosmetic, or aesthetic surgery which feminizes or masculinizes the facial or other physiological features of an individual, and any removal of any otherwise healthy or non-diseased body part or tissue.</text></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HB9EE24DC8DF4441BBF68EE79E7252AB3"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Exclusions</header><text>The term <term>specified gender transition procedure</term> shall not include, when furnished to an individual by a health care provider with the consent of such individual (or, if applicable, the parents or legal guardian of such individual)—</text> <subparagraph id="HB82B8671D17642358734D7139FB6795A"><enum>(A)</enum><text>services to individuals born with a medically verifiable disorder of sex development, including an individual with external sex characteristics which are irresolvably ambiguous, such as an individual born with 46 XX chromosomes with virilization, an individual born with 46 XY chromosomes with undervirilization, or an individual born having both ovarian and testicular tissue;</text></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H6DD3E31624C04E4F86FE167DC60CD4C4"><enum>(B)</enum><text>services relating to any other physician-diagnosed disorder of sexual development with respect to which the physician has determined through genetic or biochemical testing that the individual does not have normal sex chromosome structure, sex steroid hormone production, or sex steroid hormone action for a healthy male or female of the same age;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HBF2DDAAFA22E45A7B3BB4E20045F7B57"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the treatment of any infection, injury, disease, or disorder caused or exacerbated by the performance of gender transition procedures, without regard to whether the gender transition procedure was performed in accordance with State and Federal law or whether the gender transition procedure is treated as medical care under this section;</text></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HE22D03FD66C44D26AE5538670DD6F3DE"><enum>(D)</enum><text>any procedure undertaken because the individual suffers from a physical disorder, physical injury, or physical illness (but not mental, behavioral, or emotional distress or a mental, behavioral, or emotional disorder) which would, as certified by a physician, place the individual in imminent danger of death or impairment of major bodily function unless the procedure is performed to alleviate said physical disorder, physical injury, or physical illness;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H8A3DB42BB8E949CEBAC99CD0923AC424"><enum>(E)</enum><text>any procedure to restore or reconstruct the body of the individual in order to correspond to the individual’s sex after 1 or more previous gender transition procedures, which may include the removal of a pseudo phallus or breast augmentation;</text></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H79F59D02DDB94EEF8580CDA0410110DB"><enum>(F)</enum><text>puberty suppression or puberty-blocking prescription drugs for the purpose of normalizing puberty for an individual experiencing precocious puberty; or</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H3DF5ECD864544B7BBB8856EACEF83BEE"><enum>(G)</enum><text>male circumcision.</text></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H3A77E96226A8408CAE2FEBBC4C1CDCC4"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Additional definitions</header><text>For purposes of this subsection:</text> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H355DE4F524A742C598D19C59BE5355C9"><enum>(A)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Gender transition</header><text>The term <term>gender transition</term> means the process by which an individual goes from identifying with or presenting as his or her sex to identifying with or presenting as a self-proclaimed identity which does not correspond with or is different from his or her sex, and may be accompanied by social, legal, or physical changes.</text></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD22078AB3DB145659593DEFF0DD6AD95"><enum>(B)</enum><header>Sex</header><text>The term <term>sex</term>, when referring to an individual’s sex, means either male or female, as biologically determined, including as described in subparagraphs (C) and (D).</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H4EA1408DDF0D447B80060CD491489261"><enum>(C)</enum><header>Female</header><text>The term <term>female</term>, when used to refer to a natural person, means an individual belonging, at conception, to the sex characterized by a reproductive system with the biological function of producing eggs (ova).</text></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HAFFF3FE34BC4461192B15C490CCD6947"><enum>(D)</enum><header>Male</header><text>The term <term>male</term>, when used to refer to a natural person, means an individual belonging, at conception, to the biological sex characterized by a reproductive system with the biological function of producing sperm.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></subsection> <subsection id="H17683CF770F9434784C64D7998CFACF8"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Effective date</header><text>The amendments made by this section shall apply to services furnished on or after the date of the enactment of this Act.</text></subsection></section>

<paragraph id="H7E3897A677BA44F899F811BE246CB24C"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Delay permitted if state legislation required</header><text>If the Secretary of Health and Human Services determines that State legislation (other than legislation appropriating funds) is required in order for a State plan developed pursuant to part E of title IV of the Social Security Act to meet the additional requirements imposed by the amendments made by this Act, the plan shall not be regarded as failing to meet any of the additional requirements before the 1st day of the 1st calendar quarter beginning after the first regular session of the State legislature that begins after the date of the enactment of this Act. For purposes of the preceding sentence, if the State has a 2-year legislative session, each year of the session is deemed to be a separate regular session of the State legislature.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> </legis-body></bill>

id="H49BE5D1616294ADF804E97DF04940436"><enum>116.</enum><header>Genital and bodily mutilation of a minor; chemical castration of a minor</header><subsection id="H6D23BCB7F8AC4310BEC3524155CB8D41"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Genital or bodily mutilation</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Except as provided in subsection (g), whoever, in any circumstance described in subsection (d), knowingly performs, or attempts to perform, genital or bodily mutilation on another person who is a minor, shall be fined under this title, imprisoned not more than 10 years, or both.</text></subsection><subsection id="H71E80F8DFCD141F68C105052C981D492" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Chemical castration of a fined under this title, imprisoned not more than 10 years, or both.</text></subsection><subsection id="HD9847A0FAC9F48AEADB07F7482C6DFCF" commented="no"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Certain offense related to female genital mutilation</header><text>Except as provided in subsection (g), whoever, in any circumstance described in subsection (d), knowingly—</text><paragraph id="H04C8FAC635984AE2BC40C5645EEBF773" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">facilitates or consents to female genital mutilation of a minor; </continuation-text></subsection><subsection id="H633F12A307E14526AC50BBB028BE7480"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Circumstances described</header><text>For the purposes of subsections (a) and (b), the circumstances described in this subsection are that—</text><paragraph id="HBEB0BB2CD58B4CF58FA9BB0094A486B8"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the defendant or victim traveled in interstate or foreign commerce, </text></paragraph><paragraph id="HC86079CEBF474A97AB6AE76F0862E748"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the defendant used a means, channel, facility, or instrumentality of interstate or foreign commerce in furtherance of or in connection with the conduct described in subsection (a) or (b); </text></paragraph><paragraph id="HF26AAA70C3744E4EA4E5702A4B767B13"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">any payment of any kind was made, directly or indirectly, in furtherance of or in connection with the commerce;</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HD48ECD95A257400B87887A9B40BE8502"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the defendant transmitted in interstate or foreign commerce any id="H119C6188D2104C5CB7693F05AB985FF6"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">any instrument, item, substance, or other object that has traveled in interstate or foreign commerce </text></paragraph><paragraph id="HE66B80813BF9486DA191A8B56F10C004"><enum>(7)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the conduct described in subsection (a) or (b) otherwise occurred in or shall not be a defense to a prosecution under subsection (a) that female genital mutilation is required as a matter of religion, custom, tradition, ritual, or standard practice.</text></subsection><subsection id="H844FBFC1DC4E45E399284E5001E6ACCB"><enum>(f)</enum><header>Prohibition on prosecution of victim</header><text>No person who is chemically castrated or on id="H08E7C8EE20444A8F8A10D4C42EFDC45D"><enum>(g)</enum><header>Exceptions</header><paragraph id="H9EDD13E19DDC48DA9C557B3AC25BEB6C"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Procedures</header><subparagraph id="H7A163987B4204212978919F124312FFD"><enum>(A)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Genital or bodily mutilation or chemical castration is not a violation of this section if such genital or bodily mutilation or chemical castration is— </text><clause id="H37A12F28CFFE4E2C9FF2FDC2DA216CF1"><enum>(i)</enum><text>necessary to the health of the minor on whom it is conducted, and is conducted by a person licensed in the place of such conduct as a medical practitioner; or </text></clause><clause id="HB4F6FAC7136149598FDAC9932D7C4957"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>in the case of female genital medical practitioner, midwife, or person in training to become such a practitioner or midwife.</text></clause></subparagraph><subparagraph id="HDC592578A0924132BC7DCD9DE4CFA8BE"><enum>(B)</enum><header>Health of a minor</header><text>For the purposes of subparagraph (A), the health of a minor does not include a mental health disorder. </text></subparagraph></paragraph><paragraph id="H0C0309C89AED42A3840C66791605F915" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Exemption</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Genital or bodily id="H65A06700F89445B8809D211721C1544D" commented="no"><enum>(C)</enum><text>An individual experiencing infection, disease, injury, or disorder caused or exacerbated by previous gender transition procedures.</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H95C3ECCEDF684AA09523A08929287F5B" commented="no"><enum>(D)</enum><text>An individual suffering from a physical disorder, physical injury, or performed.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection><subsection id="H35A9C6AF2D3B4521908A98E149861D4F"><enum>(h)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In id="H4CD6AE31F1A24E6FA00371A28584D1D4"><enum>(i)</enum><text>castration;</text></clause><clause id="H4E11257A579E4D04B3896D9A758AF274"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>orchiectomy;</text></clause><clause that individuals, by virtue of race, sex, ethnicity, color, or national origin, bear collective guilt and are inherently responsible for actions committed in the past by other members of the same race, ethnicity, color, or national origin.</text></subparagraph></paragraph><paragraph id="H1F2B5703ADF84CD1B14E5472C2834C70"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Institution of higher education</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>institution of higher education</term> has the meaning given that term in section 102.</text></paragraph></subsection></section><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></section><section id="H0A89A96D651E4E3F8E61877FD53A7BD2"><enum>2.</enum><header>Conforming requirements for accrediting agencies and associations</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Section 496(a) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/20/1099b">20 U.S.C. 1099b(a)</external-xref>) is amended—</text><paragraph id="H7F157979331B4137BD4E8F91B08C3B10"><enum>(1)</enum><text>in paragraph (7), by striking <quote>and</quote> at the end;</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H819432B6C70844778D1B6927FCD0DDC6"><enum>(2)</enum><text>in paragraph (8), by striking the period at the end and inserting <quote>; and</quote>; and</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H5CE5858363E645AC8A5D8901E930D210"><enum>(3)</enum><text>by adding at the end the following:</text><quoted-block style="OLC" id="HECEFD169EE5A4AF29518F059F5FB1959" display-inline="no-display-inline"><paragraph id="H1DD65BB9DCB3439BBC499E6596FA8527"><enum>(9)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">if such agency or association has or seeks to include within its scope of recognition the evaluation of the quality of institutions or programs offering graduate medical education, such agency or association shall, in addition to meeting the other requirements of this subpart, demonstrate to the Secretary that the agency or association does not require an institution or program to adopt any policies or other requirements in contravention of section 124 as a condition of receiving accreditation from the agency or association.</text></paragraph><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph></section><section id="H3C9F9B179EA246EDB05F92971716CD28"><enum>3.</enum><header>Rules of construction</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Nothing in this Act or the amendments made by this Act shall be construed—</text><paragraph id="H6265C069BFA8481A9CF694D18AC76C8B" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to prohibit a graduate medical school at an institution of higher education from—</text><subparagraph id="H4630F14B44824F83B7CFD451FDAAC267"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">providing instruction about unique medical needs or conditions that may be related to an individual’s sex, race, or other characteristics; or</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H04AECB77694F4DE08A978C851CC379BE"><enum>(B)</enum><text>collecting and maintaining demographic data on students solely for informational purposes;</text></subparagraph></paragraph><paragraph id="HC20432CCF9CA42F6BC1D9B89C2D0D36D"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">in the case of an institution with a religious mission, to require or incentivize the institution to take any action that is contrary to the tenets of such religion; or</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HFB03285E023C4969A22C7667CF23DFE9"><enum>(3)</enum><text>to restrict or prohibit—</text><subparagraph id="H26B360DC4BA14CDD8765EEAEC4C6E06A"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the exercise of First Amendment rights by anyone lawfully present on the grounds of an institution of higher education (as defined in section 102 of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/20/1002">20 U.S.C. 1002</external-xref>));</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="HB537494FC3D648FD9E40C55A17AD96F3" commented="no"><enum>(B)</enum><text>academic instruction at such an institution, except to the extent required under paragraphs (2)(C) and (3) of section 124(a) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (as added by section 2);</text></subparagraph><subparagraph laws.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></section><section id="H501E730185AE425A9BC386F216744F7C"><enum>4.</enum><header>Severability</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">If any provision <distribution-code display="yes">I</distribution-code><congress display="yes">119th CONGRESS</congress><session display="yes">1st Session</session><legis-num display="yes">H. R. 3688</legis-num><current-chamber>IN THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES</current-chamber><action display="yes"><action-date date="20250603">June 3, 2025</action-date><action-desc><sponsor name-id="L000578">Mr. LaMalfa</sponsor> (for himself, <cosponsor name-id="G000576">Mr. Grothman</cosponsor>, <cosponsor name-id="M001211">Mrs. Miller of Illinois</cosponsor>, <cosponsor name-id="G000565">Mr. Gosar</cosponsor>, <cosponsor name-id="N000026">Mr. Nehls</cosponsor>, <cosponsor name-id="T000478">Ms. Tenney</cosponsor>, <cosponsor name-id="B000825">Ms. Boebert</cosponsor>, <cosponsor name-id="R000603">Mr. Rouzer</cosponsor>, <cosponsor name-id="A000375">Mr. Arrington</cosponsor>, <cosponsor name-id="W000814">Mr. Weber of Texas</cosponsor>, <cosponsor name-id="P000609">Mr. Palmer</cosponsor>, and <cosponsor name-id="B001295">Mr. Bost</cosponsor>) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the <committee-name committee-id="HJU00">Committee on the Judiciary</committee-name></action-desc></action><legis-type>A BILL</legis-type><official-title display="yes">To amend <external-xref legal-doc="usc-chapter" parsable-cite="usc-chapter/18/110">chapter 110</external-xref> of title 18, United States Code, to prohibit gender transition procedures on minors, and for other purposes.</official-title></form><legis-body id="HD7A13D6CA9074F838BD756C5A1A03C46" style="OLC"> 
<section id="H6E9CA989A69B42A2AD3D5ADD09CB4304" section-type="section-one"><enum>1.</enum><header>Short title</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">This Act may be cited as the <quote><short-title>Protecting Children from Experimentation Act of 2025</short-title></quote>.</text></section> <section id="H2EBC2FDCE1D64028ABFB0CD0C6B43B54"><enum>2.</enum><header>Gender transition procedures on minors prohibited</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline"><external-xref legal-doc="usc-chapter" parsable-cite="usc-chapter/18/110">Chapter 110</external-xref> of title 18, United States Code, is amended—</text> 
<paragraph id="HFAE6B718A8E24360BCE29964DBDE776E"><enum>(1)</enum><text>by adding at the end the following:</text> <quoted-block id="H527ADCF69E434E33BADCC8AA02010290" style="USC"> <section id="HD46AC315547B4E2FA37D7AE6CBF50601"><enum>2260B.</enum><header>Gender transition procedures on minors</header> <subsection id="H1805ECBD7B5C4FCD8216391F3707B9CE"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Any physical or mental health care professional who, under the circumstances described in subsection (d), knowingly performs or otherwise aids and abets the performance of a gender transition procedure on a minor shall be fined under this title, imprisoned not more than 5 years, or both.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HE893C4D7D23D4A0BA231D8A973AA2F3C"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Prohibition on prosecution of person on whom procedures are performed</header><text>No person on whom the gender transition procedure under subsection (a) is performed may be arrested or prosecuted for an offense under this section.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H90FD4A424AE34685A158D5803548289C"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Civil action</header><text>A person on whom a gender transition procedure is performed under this section may bring a civil action for appropriate relief against each person who performed the gender transition procedure.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H7A974B73AD344E988D68CA666D7BD5C6"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Circumstances described</header><text>For purposes of subsection (a), the circumstances described in this subsection are that—</text> <paragraph id="H2053325862DC45EC94BDDB8D56033D82"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the defendant or minor traveled in interstate or foreign commerce, or traveled using a means, channel, facility, or instrumentality of interstate or foreign commerce, in furtherance of or in connection with the conduct described in subsection (a);</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HC7C82E64D6D540358FE503CF96AB3DAE"><enum>(2)</enum><text>the defendant used a means, channel, facility, or instrumentality of interstate or foreign commerce in furtherance of or in connection with the conduct described in subsection (a);</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD75F44193CAB447A94D831586BA4067B"><enum>(3)</enum><text>any payment of any kind was made, directly or indirectly, in furtherance of or in connection with the conduct described in subsection (a) using any means, channel, facility, or instrumentality of interstate or foreign commerce or in or affecting interstate or foreign commerce;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H5DE5F3B5CD3D45FE8379E9A88546AE53"><enum>(4)</enum><text>the defendant transmitted in interstate or foreign commerce any communication relating to or in furtherance of the conduct described in subsection (a) using any means, channel, facility, or instrumentality of interstate or foreign commerce or in or affecting interstate or foreign commerce by any means or in manner, including by computer, mail, wire, or electromagnetic transmission;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H5877A002FC4443E3A06D890C309B9EF5"><enum>(5)</enum><text>any instrument, item, substance, or other object that has traveled in interstate or foreign commerce was used to perform the conduct described in subsection (a);</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HEAC81D0DEF3D4CDDA2FC9F006067BDEF"><enum>(6)</enum><text>the conduct described in subsection (a) occurred within the special maritime and territorial jurisdiction of the United States, or any territory or possession of the United States; or</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H2FB83EFCA5BD46BF84A07DCE0E06A440"><enum>(7)</enum><text>the conduct described in subsection (a) otherwise occurred in or affected interstate or foreign commerce.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H08C2F355C5384A669C4EF50B867E6C2F"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section:</text> <paragraph id="HFB2D453A19B942A790F6EDAF05D11C2D"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Female</header><text>The term <quote>female</quote>, when used to refer to a natural person, means an individual who naturally has, had, will have, or would have, but for a congenital anomaly, historical accident, or intentional or unintentional disruption, the reproductive system that at some point produces, transports, and utilizes eggs for fertilization.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HFF856A5DAC694FC9923A66A0569A59EE"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Gender transition</header><text>The term <quote>gender transition</quote> means the process in which an individual goes from identifying with or presenting as his or her sex to identifying with or presenting a self-proclaimed identity that does not correspond with or is different from his or her sex, and may be accompanied with social, legal, or physical changes.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HBAD7D5B484974289B10A10C47AB03CC1"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Gender transition procedure</header> <subparagraph id="HBCD4B8CA772348659B55E70AF1BE8652"><enum>(A)</enum><header>In general</header><text>The term <quote>gender transition procedure</quote> means any hormonal or surgical intervention for the purpose of gender transition, including—</text> 
<clause id="H14C45F55CF3D477EBBD38195DF4E02C2"><enum>(i)</enum><text>gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) agonists or other puberty-blocking or suppressing drugs to stop or delay normal puberty;</text></clause> <clause id="H3CB572A7C5F549499D61EF9F28F6CEA4"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>testosterone, estrogen, progesterone, or other androgens to an individual at doses that are supraphysiologic to what would normally be produced endogenously in a healthy individual of the same age and sex;</text></clause> 
<clause id="HA04FF37BC69946158ADEFDE7E3F9E7FF"><enum>(iii)</enum><text>castration;</text></clause> <clause id="H36C554CFE8B14D3E917432758F0E57CD"><enum>(iv)</enum><text>orchiectomy;</text></clause> 
<clause id="HB2BC4DBCFFD74CE89A578810395912F2"><enum>(v)</enum><text>scrotoplasty;</text></clause> <clause id="HAE980982743441AB845A4DED9536F558"><enum>(vi)</enum><text>implantation of erection or testicular prostheses;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H251CD092220B4CF5AF014A64A553D019"><enum>(vii)</enum><text>vasectomy;</text></clause> <clause id="H9DD8384B98AB4A2C905B1F9ABF277778"><enum>(viii)</enum><text>hysterectomy;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H25F86F386CEC430EA447378E7B91C9CD"><enum>(ix)</enum><text>oophorectomy;</text></clause> <clause id="HD74B0335A8B447C4857C03D07236896F"><enum>(x)</enum><text>ovariectomy;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H3A0B797782FC4840BC95CBDA22F79884"><enum>(xi)</enum><text>reconstruction of the fixed part of the urethra with or without a metoidioplasty or a phalloplasty;</text></clause> <clause id="H91E621216EB744A7812A7CCD4EE14B79"><enum>(xii)</enum><text>metoidioplasty;</text></clause> 
<clause id="HE990C19D558E44A68CBB22916C90766D"><enum>(xiii)</enum><text>penectomy;</text></clause> <clause id="H3F2CEF46A979445986AB484401304BF4"><enum>(xiv)</enum><text>phalloplasty;</text></clause> 
<clause id="HB4725517B39A42C392766EC2997C5F7C"><enum>(xv)</enum><text>vaginoplasty;</text></clause> <clause id="H33253479EB044116BAE22A6A702D5641"><enum>(xvi)</enum><text>clitoroplasty;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H077EA1CA3D29487BAAB883E04AB8282C"><enum>(xvii)</enum><text>vaginectomy;</text></clause> <clause id="HB145058F666342AA859023DD9931838D"><enum>(xviii)</enum><text>vulvoplasty;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H77085F3E520447D49951AC6EDED94BB4"><enum>(xix)</enum><text>reduction thyrochondroplasty;</text></clause> <clause id="H39A5C24976B44264BDD311F5D99EC8E5"><enum>(xx)</enum><text>chondrolaryngoplasty;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H4E09E3B603324349A0BEAE218355743B"><enum>(xxi)</enum><text>mastectomy;</text></clause> <clause id="H49CD670B8519443E82005DCA3A01D953"><enum>(xxii)</enum><text>tubal ligation;</text></clause> 
<clause id="HF022C5B45C7C4EDE9C5710AA6A65E481"><enum>(xxiii)</enum><text>sterilization;</text></clause> <clause id="HDBCA98C17F264A02B89F64651D860D13"><enum>(xxiv)</enum><text>any plastic, cosmetic, or aesthetic surgery that feminizes or masculinizes the facial or other physiological features of an individual;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H2973F7A97C40417582C1481AC6C590BE"><enum>(xxv)</enum><text>any placement of chest implants to create feminine breasts;</text></clause> <clause id="H9F740E549AFB4D9F9DB7B81CB9599EE8"><enum>(xxvi)</enum><text>any placement of fat or artificial implants in the gluteal region;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H1D28652C101F4B4CB996CE1874E0F562"><enum>(xxvii)</enum><text>augmentation mammoplasty;</text></clause> <clause id="HC61CDA8F8B2944AA8C5B36F9E96DD859"><enum>(xxviii)</enum><text>liposuction;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H77DC271D9F7E49428BAD264177CB7DD3"><enum>(xxix)</enum><text>lipofilling;</text></clause> <clause id="HD1ECAAD2E8574EF99C37DC7C1E817570"><enum>(xxx)</enum><text>voice surgery;</text></clause> 
<clause id="HDDA8CBB106704CFFA2B239A314D41380"><enum>(xxxi)</enum><text>hair reconstruction;</text></clause> <clause id="H1B64E46B69E8419988DC28C00A635BAE"><enum>(xxxii)</enum><text>pectoral implants; and</text></clause> 
<clause id="HCECAA1B711DA4288B88E823E788063F0"><enum>(xxxiii)</enum><text>the removal of any otherwise healthy or non-diseased body part or tissue.</text></clause></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H8971FB415EB24007AB1C97F8CA073BB5"><enum>(B)</enum><header>Exclusions</header><text>The term <quote>gender transition procedure</quote> does not include the following when furnished to an individual by a health care provider with the consent of such individual or, if applicable, such individual’s parents or legal guardian:</text> 
<clause id="H1CCEDD8A828741BB9BB13A0D96765C4E"><enum>(i)</enum><text>Services to individuals born with a medically verifiable disorder of sex development, including an individual with external sex characteristics that are irresolvably ambiguous, such as an individual born with 46 XX chromosomes with virilization, an individual born with 46 XY chromosomes with undervirilization, or an individual born having both ovarian and testicular tissue.</text></clause> <clause id="H57A76E66246F46E28F3C8121176304D3"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>Services provided when a physician has otherwise diagnosed a disorder of sexual development in which the physician has determined through genetic or biochemical testing that the individual does not have normal sex chromosome structure, sex steroid hormone production, or sex steroid hormone action for a healthy individual of the same sex and age.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H4D38570900F349018213EA4BA6B16CC8"><enum>(iii)</enum><text>The treatment of any infection, injury, disease, or disorder that has been caused by or exacerbated by the performance of gender transition procedures, whether or not the gender transition procedure was performed in accordance with State and Federal law or whether or not funding for the gender transition procedure is permissible under this section.</text></clause> <clause id="H2FF46310113F4A65BA75968C465157B3"><enum>(iv)</enum><text>Any procedure undertaken because the individual suffers from a physical disorder, physical injury, or physical illness (but not mental, behavioral, or emotional distress or a mental, behavioral, or emotional disorder) that would, as certified by a physician, place the individual in imminent danger of death or impairment of major bodily function, unless the procedure is performed.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H873667167E124877A4AFBBD07EC00980"><enum>(v)</enum><text>Puberty suppression or blocking prescription drugs for the purpose of normalizing puberty for a minor experiencing precocious puberty.</text></clause> <clause id="HA72B9B7AA160400D96BF3FCC38FDB9E7"><enum>(vi)</enum><text>Male circumcision.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H105B919466B04CB28B5F7EC5C7732453"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Male</header><text>The term <quote>male</quote>, when used to refer to a natural person, means an individual who naturally has, had, will have, or would have, but for a congenital anomaly, historical accident, or intentional or unintentional disruption, the reproductive system that at some point produces, transports, and utilizes sperm for fertilization.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H13F40A1E185F44EB83ECB24A7150765F"><enum>(5)</enum><header>Minor</header><text>The term <quote>minor</quote> means an individual under the age of 18.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HF5AE3ACAE71E481081C8253D4734F4B9"><enum>(6)</enum><header>Sex</header><text>The term <quote>sex</quote>, when referring to an individual’s sex, means to refer to either male or female, as biologically determined.</text></paragraph></subsection></section><after-quoted-block>; and</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph> <paragraph id="H4431A42B3B3F4209819AF619340FE901"><enum>(2)</enum><text>by amending the table of sections for such chapter by adding at the end the following:</text> 
<quoted-block id="HAA8A2607F631484C82C131696CE2CAC0" style="USC">

<legis-body id="H2837F48FF6B447D0B00F4A0A0D990C4F">
<section id="HB2B324E92C914FA69F8C8DF8012DB662" section-type="section-one"><enum>1.</enum><header>Prohibition on participation of males in athletic programs or activities at the military service academies that are designated for women or girls</header>
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H046838D4BAC54EB898B52F09FDC7F6FE"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense shall ensure that the United States Military Academy, the United States Naval Academy, and the United States Air Force Academy do not permit a person whose sex is male to participate in an athletic program or activity that is designated for women or girls.</text></subsection> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HF941E0CF72174F26BC89BC28FC4071E6"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Rule of construction</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Nothing in this section shall be construed to prohibit a recipient from permitting males to train or practice with an athletic program or activity that is designated for women or girls so long as no female is deprived of a roster spot on a team or sport, opportunity to participate in a practice or competition, scholarship, admission to an educational institution, or any other benefit that accompanies participating in the athletic program or activity.</text></subsection>
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H3294D6F30FA8449595EEF6354E3637A6"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section—</text> <paragraph id="H9EFB279625B6441AAAAD53BF0D8D7D6A"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the term <term>athletic programs and activities</term> includes all programs or activities that are provided conditional upon participation with any athletic team; and</text></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC8BC5A986D7941BA9152126971253806"><enum>(2)</enum><text>the term <term>sex</term> means a person’s reproductive biology and genetics at birth.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> </legis-body> </bill>

<bill bill-stage="Introduced-in-House" dms-id="HF72A9FB03EF24CFD9544516BA8C37D0E" public-private="public" key="H" bill-type="olc"><metadata xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">

<dc:title>119 HR 4138 IH: Restoring Biological Truth in Government Act</dc:title>
<dc:publisher>U.S. House of Representatives</dc:publisher>
<dc:date>2025-06-25</dc:date>
<dc:format>text/xml</dc:format>
<dc:language>EN</dc:language>

<form>
<distribution-code display="yes">I</distribution-code><congress display="yes">119th CONGRESS</congress><session display="yes">1st Session</session><legis-num display="yes">H. R. 4138</legis-num><current-chamber>IN THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES</current-chamber><action display="yes"><action-date date="20250625">June 25, 2025</action-date><action-desc><sponsor name-id="M000194">Ms. Mace</sponsor> (for herself and <cosponsor name-id="M001212">Mr. Moore of Alabama</cosponsor>) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the <committee-name committee-id="HGO00">Committee on Oversight and Government Reform</committee-name></action-desc></action><legis-type>A BILL</legis-type><official-title display="yes">To prohibit the heads of executive agencies from asking about gender identity on any form or survey, to require executive agencies provide male and female as the only options to respond to questions about sex or gender on any forms or surveys and for other purposes.</official-title></form><legis-body id="H2CF57D52A87943BA8A7D9F6C24F417D5" style="OLC"> 
<section id="H41A57BFF211B40CFBDF32F7C4FE56261" section-type="section-one"><enum>1.</enum><header>Short title</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">This Act may be cited as the <quote><short-title>Restoring Biological Truth in Government Act</short-title></quote>.</text></section> <section id="H0E1D71804C364622980B72A27735CC04"><enum>2.</enum><header>Prohibition on asking about gender identity on any executive agency form or survey</header> <subsection id="H42F1491BCF934648990DAC15B616E54A"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Prohibition</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">With respect to any collection of information conducted by or for an executive agency through a form or survey, the head of such agency—</text> 
<paragraph id="H4FC7628E543E4028868D5130DF5A58ED"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">may not—</text> <subparagraph id="H1A4A1B643C224ED19785C108F382F748"><enum>(A)</enum><text>solicit or obtain any information regarding the gender identity of an individual; and</text></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB8A2AE3753BC4D928FFD4FCC6501C74E"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">provide an option to select or mark on the form or survey that sex or gender of an individual is something other than male or female; and</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H480F943CA2E34FDAB010E94258A12EA7"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">shall reject the submission of any such form or survey that provides a response other than male or female to a required question on sex or gender.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HFC81A26D7DDC43F4B44EB22751DC630B"><enum>(b)</enum><header>OMB guidance</header><text>Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Director of the Office of Management and Budget shall issue guidance to the heads of covered agencies on the implementation of the provisions of this section.</text> </subsection> <subsection id="HA2ECE9C946024C1AAE58C0B241B7D21D"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this Act:</text> 
<paragraph id="HD028490455494C7EB18ECC48871D8D2B"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Executive agency</header><text>The term <term>executive agency</term> means an establishment in the executive branch of the Federal Government, including—</text> <subparagraph id="HE5F7E9FA974541719F5A9853714F048E"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the Executive Office of the President;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HF32BCD1821084F3893029F5A5F9C59BA"><enum>(B)</enum><text>any executive department;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H1BE88D4BFEE24DC8841CC9EAD3BE82C6"><enum>(C)</enum><text>any independent regulatory agency;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H3584EF239B8D44608FBA4237F893DB43"><enum>(D)</enum><text>any military department;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H5A979BFC07194D25B0D1A7036F8A0E64"><enum>(E)</enum><text>any government corporation; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H62C1780F696B43338F3787BAFD0C56CD"><enum>(F)</enum><text>any government-controlled corporation.</text> </subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H0D36139605B64CF8A84DA84B6FBA3AFD" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Female</header><text>The term <term>female</term> means an individual who naturally has, had, will have, or would have, but for a developmental or genetic anomaly or historical accident, the reproductive system that at some point produces, transports, and utilizes eggs for fertilization.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H7BD228CBF83B4465B1697A7C0CD480E4" commented="no"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Gender</header><text>The term <term>gender</term>—</text> <subparagraph id="HC3A8075640C34D398FE00093D4A0DFC8" commented="no"><enum>(A)</enum><text>means—</text> 
<clause id="HF86942C198C64E48B6F5B3B26F2AC4AC" commented="no"><enum>(i)</enum><text>males, females, or the natural differences between males and females, unless such term is otherwise specified or used alone (rather than with or as an adjective modifying other words); and</text></clause> <clause id="HB2EDC7B23E5C489F8F3BCFA5E260E6AD" commented="no"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>a synonym for sex; and</text></clause></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H79F4058FE7974BB086C6C3EF0ED2CADC" commented="no"><enum>(B)</enum><text>does not mean gender identity, experienced gender, gender expression, or gender roles.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H608173C7193345DDBD4AB652E4DE1AF8" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Gender identity</header><text>The term <term>gender identity</term> does not mean sex or gender.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H6DA0F20B7A4046AC801B99881A2AFFE1"><enum>(5)</enum><header>Male</header><text>The term <term>male</term> means an individual who naturally has, had, will have, or would have, but for a developmental or genetic anomaly or historical accident, the reproductive system that at some point produces, transports, and utilizes sperm for fertilization.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H30C97D658FE84B27AA9DB773041E8241"><enum>(6)</enum><header>Sex</header><text>The term <term>sex</term> means the biological determination as to whether an individual is male or female.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
</legis-body></bill>
